GSSSB Ophthalmic Assistant Merit List PDF: How to Download

The final result and merit list are published as a PDF in the Results section of the GSSSB website. A direct PDF link is not available officially in this article, so use the official website to open the correct file.

  1. Open the official GSSSB website, gsssb.gujarat.gov.in.
  2. Go to the Result section on the home page.
  3. Find the notice for Ophthalmic Assistant, Class-3, Advertisement No. 344/202526.
  4. Click the final result link to open the PDF.
  5. Search the list for your confirmation number or name.
  6. Download the PDF and save or print a copy for future use.

How to Read the Final Result PDF

  • Check whether your name appears in the select list, the waiting list or any list of unsuccessful candidates.
  • Note your merit position, marks, category and any office or district allotment shown against your name.
  • If your name is not in the select list, check the waiting list, as candidates on it can be called if selected candidates do not join.

What Happens After the GSSSB Ophthalmic Assistant Final Result?

Details of the post-result process, such as document verification dates, appointment letters, joining timelines and office allotment, are Not Yet Announced in the information available here. Selected candidates should keep checking the official GSSSB website and the notices of the Health and Family Welfare Department for updates.

  • Do not depend on messages or posts from unofficial accounts about joining dates.
  • Keep your OJAS login details and confirmation number safe.
  • Candidates on the waiting list should also keep their documents ready, as the waiting list is used only if vacancies remain.

Documents to Keep Ready for the Next Stage

An official post-result document checklist is Not Available Officially. The list below is indicative and based on what is commonly asked in government recruitment. Follow the instructions in the official notice when it is issued.

  • Printout of the final result or merit list entry and the application confirmation
  • Photo identity proof
  • Educational certificates and mark sheets for Optometry or the Ophthalmic Science diploma
  • Experience certificate, if applicable to your qualification route
  • Category or caste certificate, if you applied under a reserved category
  • Computer knowledge certificate, if applicable
  • Recent passport size photographs

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Check the result only on the official GSSSB website and the OJAS portal.
  • Verify the advertisement number 344/202526 before reading any list.
  • Recheck your name, category and marks. Report any discrepancy to the board through its official channels.
  • Do not pay money to anyone who promises selection, a transfer or a joining letter.
  • Keep checking the official website for notices on the next stage.

What After RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026?

Candidates shortlisted in the Mains Result must now appear for the Language Proficiency Test (LPT), the final stage of the RBI Assistant selection process. The LPT tests a candidate's ability to read, write, speak, and understand the official/local language of the RBI office for which they applied. Candidates who studied the relevant local language up to the 10th or 12th standard are generally exempted; others must appear for and clear the LPT to remain in contention for final selection. The LPT is qualifying in nature no marks from it are added to the final merit list, but clearing it is mandatory. RBI is yet to announce the exact LPT schedule, venue, and reporting-time details for this cycle; candidates should watch the official portal for this notification.

The Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission has issued hall tickets for candidates eligible to participate in the Field Assistant Physical Fitness Test under the Combined Technical Services Examination (Diploma Level)-II.

The Field Assistant hall ticket is specifically for the physical assessment stage. It should not be confused with admit cards issued for other Combined Technical Services examinations, including separate Diploma/ITI, Non-Interview or Interview recruitment notifications.

Candidates should use their registered application credentials to access the correct hall ticket and carefully read the instructions before attending the test.

TNPSC CTS Field Assistant Physical Fitness Test Date 2026

The TNPSC Field Assistant Physical Fitness Test is scheduled to be conducted over four days, from 11 November to 14 November 2026.

Candidates should attend on the date and at the venue allotted in their individual hall tickets. The available reports do not specify a common reporting time or a single test venue for all candidates.

  • Follow the gate-closing time strictly, as late entry may not be permitted.
  • Cooperate with the security check and identity verification.
  • Keep the admit card safe even after the exam.

Read the admit card instructions carefully. Do not arrive late.
Carry original ID proof and the printed admit card. Do not carry prohibited electronic devices.
Follow the instructions given by the invigilator. Do not communicate with other candidates during the exam.

NICL AO Selection Process 2026

The selection process for NICL AO has three stages:

  1. Phase I: Preliminary Examination (online), common for all disciplines.
  2. Phase II: Main Examination (online) with an objective test of 250 marks and a descriptive test of 30 marks.
  3. Interview: Candidates are shortlisted on the basis of Mains objective test marks, subject to qualifying the descriptive test.

Final merit is prepared on the Mains objective test and the Interview in the ratio 80:20. Appointment is subject to medical fitness.

Follow these steps to download your IBPS PO Mains call letter online:

If you have misplaced your registration number or password, you can retrieve it using the steps below:

Important Instructions for the IBPS PO Mains Exam

Candidates must follow these exam-day guidelines carefully:

  • Carry a printed copy of the IBPS PO Mains Admit Card along with an original valid photo ID proof.
  • Reach the exam centre at least 30 to 45 minutes before the reporting time mentioned on the call letter.
  • Carry 2 to 3 passport-size photographs identical to the one uploaded on the call letter.
  • Electronic devices, smartwatches, calculators, Bluetooth devices, and study materials are not allowed inside the exam hall.
  • Biometric verification will be conducted at the exam centre to maintain the integrity of the process.
  • Ensure the photograph and signature printed on the admit card are clear and legible.
  • Scribe-related documents are required only for candidates using a registered scribe under PwBD guidelines.

What to Do in Case of an Error on the Admit Card?

If you notice any mistake or discrepancy on your IBPS PO Mains Admit Card, follow these steps:

  1. Verify your name spelling, date of birth, registration number, and category carefully.
  2. Check whether your photograph and signature are clearly visible.
  3. Confirm the centre name, shift timing, and full address are correct.
  4. Contact the IBPS helpdesk through the official support email or helpline number given on the portal.
  5. Keep your online application form and registration acknowledgement ready for faster resolution.
  6. Download the corrected admit card once the issue has been updated by IBPS.

IBPS PO Mains Exam Date and Pattern 2026

The IBPS PO Mains exam will be held on 4 October 2026. It is a Computer-Based Test that evaluates candidates on Reasoning & Computer Aptitude, General/Economy/Banking Awareness, English Language, and Data Analysis & Interpretation, along with a descriptive English Language Writing Test (Essay & Letter). Negative marking applies for wrong answers in the objective sections. Exact sectional timings, marks distribution, and negative-marking ratio are not available in the source material used for this article and should be checked on the admit card and the official notification.

LIC HFL Apprentice Recruitment 2026: LIC Housing Finance Limited (LIC HFL) has invited online applications for 232 Graduate Apprentice training positions under Apprenticeship Program-010. Candidates who have completed graduation in any stream from a UGC/AICTE-recognized university or institute and meet the prescribed eligibility conditions can apply. The age limit is 20 to 25 years as on 1 October 2026. Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 16,650 in specified metro cities and Rs. 14,150 in other cities during the 12-month training period. Online applications are open from 20 October to 1 November 2026 through the NATS portal. Eligible applicants must also complete the BFSI SSC examination registration and fee payment by 1 November 2026.

LIC HFL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Overview

Organization LIC Housing Finance Limited (LIC HFL)
Program Name LICHFL Apprenticeship Program-010
Post Name Graduate Apprentice
Total Training Positions 232
Qualification Graduation in Any Stream from a UGC/AICTE-Recognized University or Institute

Monthly Stipend Rs. 14,150 - Rs. 16,650

Examination Fee Payment Last Date 1 November 2026
Entrance Examination Date 7 November 2026
Selection Process Online Entrance Examination, Document Verification and Personal Interview
Training Location Various LIC HFL Offices Across India
Official Website www.lichousing.com

Important: This is apprenticeship training and not regular employment. Candidates who already have a running, terminated or completed apprenticeship contract with another organization are not eligible. LIC HFL does not guarantee employment after completion of the training.

LIC HFL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Event Date
Online Application Start Date 20 October 2026

Last Date for BFSI SSC Examination Registration and Fee Payment 1 November 2026
Online Entrance Examination Date 7 November 2026

Candidates must complete the NATS application and the separate BFSI SSC examination registration process within the prescribed deadlines. Registration on NATS alone does not complete the examination-registration process.

LIC HFL Apprentice Vacancy 2026

LIC Housing Finance Limited has announced 232 apprenticeship positions across its offices in various Indian states and cities. The full city-wise vacancy distribution is provided in Table E of the official advertisement.

LIC HFL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

LIC Housing Finance Limited has issued the LICHFL Apprenticeship Program-010 Advertisement Notification for 232 Graduate Apprentice positions.

The official 10-page advertisement provides eligibility criteria, apprenticeship stipend, application dates, fee details, examination pattern, selection process and state/city-wise vacancy distribution.

Official Notification PDF: Download LIC HFL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

LIC HFL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Applicants must have completed graduation in any stream from a university or institute recognized by UGC/AICTE and satisfy the age and previous apprenticeship restrictions.

Eligibility Criteria Requirement
Educational Qualification Graduation in Any Stream
Recognized Institution UGC/AICTE-Recognized University or Institute
Qualification Completion Cut-Off 1 October 2026
Graduation Passing-Date Condition Not Before 1 October 2001, as Printed in the Advertisement
Age Limit 20 to 25 Years
Previous Apprenticeship No Running, Terminated or Completed Apprenticeship Contract with Another Organization

Important: The notification expressly states that candidates must have completed graduation by 1 October 2026 and must not have a running, terminated or completed apprenticeship contract with another organization.

The advertisement prints the earliest graduation date as 1 October 2001. Candidates should verify this unusually broad passing-date condition with LIC HFL or BFSI SSC rather than assume a different year.

LIC HFL Apprentice Age Limit 2026

Candidates must be between 20 and 25 years of age as on 1 October 2026.

Age Criteria Details
Minimum Age 20 Years
Maximum Age 25 Years
Age Calculation Date 1 October 2026

The uploaded advertisement does not separately provide a category-wise age-relaxation table.

LIC HFL Apprentice Stipend 2026

Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 16,650 in specified metro cities and Rs. 14,150 in other cities during the 12-month apprenticeship training.

Training Location Monthly Stipend
Specified Metro Cities Rs. 16,650
Other Cities Rs. 14,150

Cities Eligible for Rs. 16,650 Monthly Stipend

The higher stipend applies to training positions in Ahmedabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune and Surat.

Apprentices engaged in other notified cities will receive Rs. 14,150 per month.

Note: These are apprenticeship stipends, not salaries for regular LIC Housing Finance Limited employees.

LIC HFL Apprentice Training Duration 2026

Particulars Details
Training Programme Graduate Apprenticeship
Training Duration 12 Months
Expected Joining Fourth Week of November 2026 (Tentative)
Monthly Stipend Rs. 14,150 or Rs. 16,650
Certificate Proficiency Certificate Issued by BOAT after Successful Completion

Successful apprentices will receive a proficiency certificate from the Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT). They may contact BFSI SSC regarding available placement opportunities after completing the programme, but LIC HFL is not obligated to provide permanent employment.

LIC HFL Apprentice Application Fee 2026

The application, intimation and examination charges are payable online through BFSI Sector Skill Council of India. The fee varies according to the candidate's category and gender.

Category Application / Examination Fee
SC / ST Candidates Rs. 200 + GST
PwBD Candidates Rs. 200 + GST
General / EWS / OBC - Male Candidates Rs. 800 + GST
General / EWS / OBC - Female / Transgender Candidates Rs. 600 + GST

Fee Payment Last Date: 1 November 2026.

Payment Mode: Online through the secure payment link supplied by BFSI SSC.

The examination fee is non-refundable, including when a candidate does not attend the test or is not selected. No offline payment mode is accepted.

LIC HFL Apprentice Selection Process 2026

Selection will include an online remote-proctored entrance examination, followed by document verification and a personal interview for shortlisted candidates.

  1. NATS Registration: Eligible graduates must register and apply for the LIC HFL apprenticeship opportunity through NATS.
  2. BFSI SSC Examination Registration: Eligible applicants receive an email requesting additional application details, training location preferences and fee payment.
  3. Online Entrance Examination: Candidates who complete the examination registration and fee payment appear in the remote-proctored test.
  4. Document Verification and Personal Interview: Candidates shortlisted on the basis of the entrance examination are invited to LIC HFL offices.
  5. Final Engagement: Selected candidates receive an engagement letter mentioning the training branch, stipend and apprenticeship conditions.

The advertisement does not specify fixed weightages for the written test and interview in a combined final merit formula.

LIC HFL Apprentice Exam Pattern 2026

The entrance examination will be conducted by BFSI Sector Skill Council of India on 7 November 2026. It contains 100 objective questions carrying 100 marks, with a total duration of 60 minutes.

Subject Questions Marks
General / Financial Awareness 25 25
General English 25 25
Reasoning Ability and Computer Aptitude 25 25
Quantitative Aptitude 25 25
Total 100 100
Exam Mode Online Remote-Proctored
Exam Date 7 November 2026
Total Questions 100
Maximum Marks 100
Duration 60 Minutes
Test Medium English / Hindi, as Notified
Negative Marking Not Specified in the Advertisement

LIC HFL Apprentice Remote Examination Instructions

  • The examination must be taken remotely from the candidate's residence.
  • Candidates require a suitable camera-enabled desktop, laptop, tablet or smartphone with a reliable internet connection.
  • Candidates must remain isolated from other people during the examination, except where approved accommodations apply.
  • Aadhaar Card must be displayed for identity verification as instructed by the examination authority.
  • BFSI SSC will communicate the examination link and login credentials one day before the examination.
  • Further examination instructions will be provided through the official information handout.

Important: Candidates must complete the separate BFSI SSC examination registration. Failure to register for the written test will lead to disqualification from further participation.

LIC HFL Apprentice Apply Online 2026

Eligible graduates must apply for LIC HFL Apprenticeship Program-010 through the official National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal between 20 October and 1 November 2026.

Apply Online / NATS Registration: LIC HFL Graduate Apprentice Application Portal

BFSI SSC Examination Registration and Fee Payment: BFSI SSC BEEP Portal

Last Date: 1 November 2026.

Candidates must complete NATS registration and apply for the LIC HFL apprenticeship advertisement. They must then follow the BFSI SSC email instructions to submit the additional details and examination fee.

How to Apply Online for LIC HFL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?

  1. Visit the official NATS website at nats.education.gov.in.
  2. Open the Student Register/Login section.
  3. Complete NATS registration if not already registered.
  4. Log in and locate the LIC Housing Finance Limited apprenticeship advertisement for Program-010.
  5. Read the eligibility conditions, training locations and application instructions.
  6. Apply for the eligible LIC HFL apprenticeship opportunity.
  7. Save the NATS Enrolment ID for future correspondence.
  8. Check the registered email account for communication from BFSI SSC at [email protected].
  9. Follow the email instructions and open the BFSI SSC BEEP portal to provide additional application details and training location preferences.
  10. Pay the applicable application/examination fee online by 1 November 2026.
  11. Ensure that the details entered during examination registration match the NATS registration information.
  12. Check the registered email for examination instructions and login details before the 7 November 2026 examination.

Important: Candidates should retain their NATS Enrolment ID, registration credentials and examination fee payment information. Incorrect or mismatched registration details may lead to disqualification.

Documents Required for LIC HFL Apprentice Recruitment 2026

The advertisement refers to Aadhaar-based identity verification, educational eligibility and document verification for shortlisted candidates. Applicants should keep the applicable supporting records ready.

  • Aadhaar Card used for NATS registration and examination identity verification.
  • Graduation degree certificate and relevant marksheets.
  • Proof of date of birth.
  • NATS Enrolment ID and registration details.
  • Category or PwBD certificate, if claiming the applicable examination fee concession.
  • Application/examination fee payment confirmation.
  • Other documents requested by BFSI SSC or LIC HFL during document verification.

The advertisement does not provide a comprehensive document upload size or format table. Candidates should follow the current portal instructions for exact submission requirements.

LIC HFL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Document Verification and Interview

Candidates shortlisted based on the entrance examination result will be invited for document verification and a personal interview at LIC Housing Finance Limited offices on 15 November 2026, according to the notified schedule.

The selection authority will communicate the applicable interview and verification details to shortlisted candidates.

LIC HFL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • LIC HFL has announced 232 Graduate Apprentice training positions.
  • Candidates must have completed graduation in any stream from a UGC/AICTE-recognized institution.
  • The prescribed age limit is 20 to 25 years as on 1 October 2026.
  • Candidates with a running, terminated or completed apprenticeship contract with another organization are not eligible.
  • Online applications through NATS close on 1 November 2026.
  • Separate BFSI SSC examination registration and fee payment must also be completed by 1 November 2026.
  • The examination fee is non-refundable.
  • The online entrance examination is scheduled for 7 November 2026.
  • Document verification and personal interviews are scheduled for 15 November 2026.
  • The training duration is 12 months.
  • The monthly stipend depends on the training city.
  • Apprentices are trainees, not regular LIC HFL employees.
  • Completion of training does not guarantee full-time employment.

India Post Skilled Artisan Recruitment 2026: The Department of Posts, Mail Motor Services (MMS), Kolkata, has issued a corrigendum dated 29 October 2026, inviting applications for 19 Skilled Artisan / Tradesman posts in seven trades, including MV Mechanic, MV Electrician, Tyreman, Blacksmith, Painter, Upholsterer and Carpenter & Joiner. Candidates with a Government-recognized trade certificate or 8th Pass qualification with one year of relevant trade experience can apply. The pay scale is Rs. 19,900 to Rs. 63,200 under Level 2 of the 7th CPC. Applications must reach the designated Kolkata office through Speed Post only by 30 November 2026, 5:00 PM.

India Post Skilled Artisan Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must possess a recognized certificate in the relevant trade or have passed 8th standard with at least one year of experience in that trade. MV Mechanic applicants must additionally hold a valid Heavy Motor Vehicle driving licence.

However, supporting documents must be furnished for the eligibility route claimed.

MV Mechanic Driving Licence Requirement

Candidates applying for the MV Mechanic trade must possess a valid HMV driving licence to drive vehicles for testing purposes. The application must include a self-attested copy of the licence or licence extract.

The HMV driving licence requirement applies specifically to MV Mechanic and is not stated as a general condition for all seven trades.

For Ex-Servicemen, the notification provides relaxation after deduction of qualifying military service in the Motor Vehicle Mechanic trade from actual age. The additional relaxation is up to three years for UR, six years for OBC and eight years for SC/ST candidates, under the stated conditions.

SC/ST/OBC-NCL age relaxation applies in respect of vacancies reserved for the respective category.

India Post Skilled Artisan Application Fee 2026

Candidates should not assume an application fee or exemption unless it is confirmed by the applicable official recruitment instructions.

India Post Skilled Artisan Selection Process 2026

Selection will be made through a Competitive Trade Test based on the syllabus of the respective trade. Applications will first be examined against the prescribed qualifications and supporting documents.

  1. Scrutiny of applications and eligibility documents.
  2. Shortlisting of eligible candidates for the trade test.
  3. Competitive Trade Test in the respective trade.
  4. Selection based on the prescribed qualification, experience, category-wise vacancies and trade test performance.

The syllabus, test date, venue and duration will be communicated to eligible candidates through their Hall Permits. The notification does not specify a common written examination pattern or total marks for the trade test.

Important: Meeting the minimum qualification does not guarantee a call for the trade test. The department will not entertain correspondence regarding rejected applications.

India Post Skilled Artisan Apply Offline 2026

Eligible candidates must submit their application in the prescribed format through Speed Post only. Applications sent by courier or other transmission methods will not be considered.

Application Postal Address

To,
The Senior Manager,
Mail Motor Services,
139, Beleghata Road,
Kolkata - 700015.

Last Date for Receipt: 30 November 2026, up to 5:00 PM.

Important: Candidates applying for multiple trades must send separate applications in separate envelopes. Each envelope must clearly mention the trade applied for.

How to Apply for India Post Skilled Artisan Recruitment 2026?

  1. Visit the official India Post website at www.indiapost.gov.in.
  2. Refer to the Skilled Artisan / Tradesman corrigendum issued by Mail Motor Services, Kolkata, dated 29 October 2026.
  3. Read the eligibility criteria, category-wise vacancies, driving licence requirements and application instructions.
  4. Obtain the prescribed application format included on page 4 of the notification.
  5. Print the form and enter the trade name, personal information, category, contact details, date of birth, educational qualifications and technical experience.
  6. Enter driving licence details if applying for MV Mechanic.
  7. Affix one recent passport-size photograph in the designated space and self-attest it.
  8. Sign the completed application form.
  9. Attach self-attested photocopies of the required educational, technical, identity, experience and category documents.
  10. Place the application and supporting documents in an envelope and write "Application for the post of / Name of Trade: [Trade Name]" on the envelope.
  11. Send the envelope through Speed Post only to the Senior Manager, Mail Motor Services, 139, Beleghata Road, Kolkata - 700015.
  12. Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 30 November 2026 at 5:00 PM.

Note for Previous Applicants: Candidates who already applied under the 2018 or 2020 notifications will be considered. The department states that submitting a fresh application mentioning the current trade preference is preferable. If multiple applications are received from the same candidate, only the latest will be considered.

Documents Required for India Post Skilled Artisan Recruitment 2026

Applicants must attach self-attested photocopies of the documents applicable to their qualification and reservation claims.

  • Age proof, such as Birth Certificate, Class 10 Certificate or School Leaving Certificate.
  • Address proof.
  • Indian citizenship proof, such as Passport, Voter ID, Birth Certificate, Domicile or other acceptable Government-issued document.
  • Educational qualification certificate.
  • Relevant trade or technical qualification certificate, such as ITI, where applicable.
  • HMV Driving Licence or licence extract for MV Mechanic applicants.

India Post Skilled Artisan Application Rejection Conditions

Mail Motor Services, Kolkata, may reject applications that do not comply with the prescribed submission and eligibility requirements.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026: Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) have announced 1,688 vacancies for 12th-pass candidates under CEN No. 07/2026. The recruitment includes Commercial cum Ticket Clerk, Accounts Clerk cum Typist, Junior Clerk cum Typist and Trains Clerk posts. Online applications open on 15 October 2026 and close on 13 November 2026 at 11:59 PM through the unified RRB recruitment website.

This Railway NTPC 2026 Undergraduate recruitment offers initial basic pay of Rs. 19,900 to Rs. 21,700, depending on the post. Candidates aged 18 to 30 years as on 1 January 2027, with applicable relaxations, can apply if they meet the Class 12 qualification and medical requirements. Selection includes CBT-1, CBT-2, document verification and medical examination. No separate typing skill test will be conducted under CEN 07/2026. Candidates should check the post-wise vacancies, age limit, application fee, RRB preferences and examination pattern before applying.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026 Overview

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026 is being conducted under Centralised Employment Notice 07/2026 for four Non-Technical Popular Categories posts. The following table covers the vacancy count, qualification, age, salary, application dates, fee, refund, selection process, examination pattern and other important candidate requirements.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Eligibility Criteria 2026

Applicants for RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026 must have passed Class 12 or an equivalent examination from a recognized board. The notification normally requires at least 50% aggregate marks, but specified candidates are exempt from this minimum-percentage condition.

RRB NTPC 12th Pass Educational Qualification 2026

Accounts Clerk cum Typist 12th Pass or equivalent with 50% aggregate marks, subject to exemptions
Junior Clerk cum Typist 12th Pass or equivalent with 50% aggregate marks, subject to exemptions
Trains Clerk 12th Pass or equivalent with 50% aggregate marks, subject to exemptions

Qualification Cut-off: The required educational qualification must be completed by 13 November 2026. Candidates awaiting final examination results are not eligible to apply.

Is 50% Required in Class 12 for RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026?

Normally, candidates must secure at least 50% aggregate marks in Class 12. However, the minimum 50% condition is not applicable to the following candidates:

  • Scheduled Caste candidates.
  • Scheduled Tribe candidates.
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities.
  • Ex-Servicemen.
  • Candidates possessing qualifications higher than Class 12.

Can Graduates Apply for RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026?

Yes. Candidates with qualifications higher than Class 12 can apply for the undergraduate posts if they satisfy the prescribed age, medical and other eligibility conditions. The 50% Class 12 minimum marks condition is not insisted upon for such candidates.

The RRB NTPC Undergraduate application fee is Rs. 500 for general applicants and Rs. 250 for the eligible concessional categories listed in the notification. Part or all of the examination fee is refundable, after deduction of applicable bank charges, only to candidates who appear in the first-stage CBT.

RRB NTPC Examination Fee Refund Rules 2026

  • Only candidates appearing in CBT-1 are eligible for the prescribed refund.
  • The refund is subject to deduction of applicable bank charges.
  • Refunds are processed to an Aadhaar-seeded bank account as provided in the notification.
  • Candidates must ensure their bank account is correctly linked with Aadhaar.
  • Rejected or incomplete applications do not qualify for a fee refund.

Important: Economically Backward Class (EBC), Economically Weaker Section (EWS) and Other Backward Class (OBC) are different categories. EBC concession is based on the conditions specified in the notification and does not itself provide job reservation.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Selection Process 2026

The recruitment process consists of two Computer Based Tests, followed by document verification and medical examination. Unlike several previous NTPC recruitment cycles, CEN 07/2026 does not require a separate Computer Based Typing Skill Test for Junior Clerk cum Typist or Accounts Clerk cum Typist.

  1. CBT-1: First-stage Computer Based Test for all four posts.
  2. CBT-2: Second-stage Computer Based Test for shortlisted candidates.
  3. Document Verification: Verification of original educational, identity, category and other required documents.
  4. Medical Examination: Candidates must pass the prescribed medical fitness standard for their allotted post.

Is There a Typing Test in RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026?

No. The Computer Based Typing Skill Test for Junior Clerk cum Typist and Accounts Clerk cum Typist has been dispensed with under CEN 07/2026. Candidates are still expected to possess basic computer and adequate typing proficiency, which may be assessed after joining.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate CBT-1 Exam Pattern 2026

The RRB NTPC Undergraduate first-stage CBT contains 100 objective-type questions for 100 marks. The examination duration is 90 minutes, and one-third of a mark is deducted for every incorrect answer.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Syllabus 2026

The RRB NTPC Undergraduate syllabus for CBT-1 and CBT-2 covers Mathematics, General Intelligence and Reasoning, and General Awareness. Both stages have the same broad subjects but different question distributions.

  • Mensuration

  • Number and Alphabetical Series
  • Coding and Decoding
  • Mathematical Operations
  • Similarities and Differences
  • Relationships and Analytical Reasoning
  • Syllogism
  • Venn Diagrams
  • Puzzles and Data Sufficiency
  • Statement and Conclusion
  • Decision Making
  • Maps and Graph Interpretation

  • Indian History and Freedom Struggle
  • Indian and World Geography

Can Candidates with LASIK Surgery Apply for RRB NTPC Undergraduate 2026?

Candidates who have undergone LASIK or another procedure to correct refractive error are not eligible for posts requiring A-3 medical standards under this notification. For B-2 and C-2 posts, eligibility is subject to the medical conditions specified in the official notification.

How to Apply Online for RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates must submit only one online application through the unified official RRB website from 15 October to 13 November 2026. Candidates must carefully choose the RRB and their post preferences because important details cannot be changed later.

  1. Visit https://rrb.indianrailways.gov.in/.
  2. Open the recruitment link for CEN No. 07/2026 - NTPC Undergraduate.
  3. Read the detailed notification, Annexure A and RRB-wise vacancy tables in Annexure B.
  4. Click Create an Account if you are a new applicant. Candidates who already created an RRB account for earlier CENs should use their existing login credentials.
  5. Register using the required personal details, active mobile number and email address.
  6. Complete Aadhaar or other permitted identity verification as directed by the application portal.
  7. Choose one Railway Recruitment Board.
  8. Enter the required personal, educational and reservation details.
  9. Select eligible posts, Railway Zones and Production Unit preferences carefully.
  10. Complete the live photograph capture as instructed by the portal.
  11. Upload the scanned signature and applicable supporting documents.
  12. Review the information and declaration carefully.
  13. Pay the prescribed examination fee using the available online payment method.
  14. Submit the application and retain the confirmation details.

Important: The selected RRB and details entered during Create an Account cannot be modified later. Candidates must not submit multiple applications.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Photo and Signature Requirements 2026

The RRB application process includes live photograph capture and upload of the candidate's signature. Candidates should follow the exact instructions to avoid application rejection.

Live Photograph Requirements

  • The candidate's photograph must be captured live through the application system.
  • Do not upload or photograph an existing printed photograph.
  • Follow the portal's instructions for face positioning, lighting and identity matching.

The notification also requires eligible SC/ST candidates seeking a free train travel pass to upload the prescribed community certificate in PDF format.

The RRB NTPC Undergraduate application modification window will remain open from 16 November to 25 November 2026. Candidates can change permitted application details by paying a non-refundable modification fee of Rs. 250 for each modification.

  • General Manager (HR): Administration Department and Human Resource functions at the corporate office, including planning, organizing, staffing, development, coordination and periodical review of policies, systems and procedures. The post also handles Bi-partite/Tri-partite Settlements, adjudication, labour law cases and service matters.
  • Manager (Finance): Institutional Finance, Budgetary Planning and Control, Central Treasury Management, Resources Generation, control of Accounts, Investment Planning, Auditing, Financial Analysis and Reporting, Taxation, Finance and Costing of Projects and MIS.   13. Submit the online form before 28 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.
  14. Save or print the application confirmation for future reference.

Important: Candidates can apply for more than one post if eligible, but must not submit duplicate applications for the same post or trade. Examination dates for different posts may coincide.

Documents Required for GRSE Recruitment 2026

Applicants must upload the documents supporting their eligibility and produce original certificates during document verification.

  • 10th Pass certificate and marksheet.
  • Age or date-of-birth proof.
  • Relevant NAC/NTC trade certificate for Journeyman applicants.
  • Commercial LMV Driving Licence for Driver (Vehicle) applicants.

  • Experience certificates or accepted employment records, where required.
  • SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS certificates, where applicable.
  • PwBD certificate, if applicable.
  • Ex-Serviceman or Ex-Agniveer documents, where applicable.
  • No Objection Certificate for eligible serving employees, where required.
  • Other documents specified by the online application portal.

Experience Certificate Rule: Driver applicants must provide documentary evidence of their qualifying six years of driving experience. GRSE may require appointment letters, recent pay slips, relieving details and additional employer confirmation during verification.

GRSE Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • The recruitment includes 55 Journeyman posts and 3 Driver (Vehicle) posts.
  • The qualification and experience cut-off date is 1 October 2026.
  • The maximum age is 26 years for Journeyman and 32 years for Driver (Vehicle), with applicable relaxation.

  • Driver candidates must meet the commercial driving licence and six-year driving experience requirements.

  • Shortlisted candidates must produce original certificates for verification.

AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026: The Atomic Energy Education Society (AEES), an autonomous body under the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India, has issued Recruitment Notification 01/2026 for 254 teaching and related vacancies, including Principal, Vice-Principal, PGT, TGT, Librarian, Primary Teacher (PRT), PRT Music and Balvatika Teacher. Candidates with the prescribed 12th Pass, Graduation, Postgraduation, teaching qualifications, CTET or relevant experience can apply according to the post requirements. The pay scales range from Rs. 35,400 to Rs. 2,09,200 across Pay Levels 6 to 12. Eligible candidates can apply online from 2 November 2026 to 22 November 2026 through aees.onlineregistrationforms.com.

Selection Process Computer Based Test (CBT), Interview or Skill Test and Medical Examination
Job Location AEES Schools Across India
Official Website aees.gov.in

Important: Educational qualifications, CTET requirements, experience and maximum age vary by post. Candidates selected for AEES institutions may be posted anywhere in India, and requests for a change of initial posting location will not be entertained.

AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

The Atomic Energy Education Society has issued Recruitment Notification 01/2026 for 254 posts across its schools in India. The detailed notification includes category-wise and subject-wise vacancies, academic qualifications, age relaxation, selection rules, application fees, examination patterns and document requirements.

Official Recruitment Notices: AEES Recruitment Notice PDF

AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Applicants must satisfy the prescribed educational qualification, teacher-training requirements, CTET conditions and experience rules for their selected post. The notification provides different eligibility routes for school leadership, postgraduate teaching and primary-level teaching positions.

AEES Post-Wise Educational Qualification

Post Name Educational Qualification
Principal Master's Degree with at least 50% marks, prescribed B.Ed./Integrated Education qualification with 50% marks, relevant senior teaching or administrative experience, and computer knowledge.
Vice-Principal Master's Degree with at least 50% marks, prescribed B.Ed./Integrated Education qualification with 50% marks, required experience as Vice-Principal or PGT/Lecturer, and computer knowledge.
PGT Relevant Postgraduate Degree with at least 50% marks and prescribed B.Ed./Integrated Education qualification, or the eligible integrated postgraduate teacher-education route.
PGT Computer Science M.Sc. Computer Science/IT, MCA or M.E./M.Tech. in Computer Science/IT with at least 50% marks, along with the prescribed B.Ed./Integrated Education qualification.
TGT Relevant Bachelor's/Integrated Degree with the prescribed subject combination and teacher-education qualification, and CTET Paper-II for applicable TGT posts.
TGT Computer Science B.Sc. Computer Science/IT, BCA, B.E./B.Tech. Computer Science/IT/Computer Engineering, or the prescribed DOEACC 'A' Level with Graduation route, along with B.Ed. and required marks.
TGT Physical & Health Education Prescribed Physical Education degree or Graduation with B.P.Ed., with required marks.
TGT Art Education Relevant Bachelor's Degree in Drawing and Painting/Sculpture/Graphic Art/Fine Arts with prescribed marks and B.Ed.
Librarian Bachelor's Degree in Library Science or Library & Information Science with at least 50% marks, and computer application knowledge.
Primary Teacher (PRT) 12th Pass with at least 50% marks and the prescribed D.El.Ed., B.El.Ed. or Special Education Diploma route, along with CTET Paper-I.
PRT Music 12th Pass with 50% marks and Bachelor's Degree in Music/Performing Arts with Music as the main subject throughout the degree.
Balvatika Teacher 12th Pass with at least 50% marks, English as a subject at Class 12 level, and the prescribed Nursery/Pre-School/Early Childhood Education Diploma or B.Ed. (Nursery).

Important: The table summarizes the principal qualification routes. Candidates must verify the exact subject combinations, minimum marks, alternative qualifications and experience requirements in Recruitment Notification 01/2026 before applying.

AEES Principal Eligibility 2026

Principal candidates must have a Master's Degree with at least 50% marks, a qualifying B.Ed. or integrated teacher-education qualification with at least 50% marks, and computer knowledge.

They must also satisfy one of the prescribed experience routes:

  • Working as Principal in Pay Level 12 in an eligible Government or autonomous organization.
  • Three years as Vice-Principal in Pay Level 10.
  • Twelve years of regular service as PGT/Lecturer in Pay Level 8.
  • Twelve years of combined qualifying service as PGT and Vice-Principal under the notified conditions.

AEES Vice-Principal Eligibility 2026

Vice-Principal applicants must have a Master's Degree with at least 50% marks, the prescribed teacher-education qualification, and computer knowledge.

Eligible experience routes include working as Vice-Principal in Pay Level 10 or at least six years as PGT/Lecturer in Pay Level 8 in the specified Government or autonomous organizations.

AEES TGT Subject Combination Requirements

The notification specifies subject combinations for certain TGT positions that must be satisfied at Graduation level.

Marathi Marathi as Elective/Main Subject for at least 3 Years or 6 Semesters
Mathematics-Physics Mathematics for 3 Years/6 Semesters, Physics for at least 1 Year/2 Semesters, and one of Chemistry, Electronics, Computer Science or Statistics for at least 1 Year/2 Semesters
Chemistry-Biology Prescribed Biology/Life Science/Botany/Zoology Main Subject with Required Chemistry and Biological Science Subsidiary Subjects
Social Studies Two of History, Geography, Economics and Political Science, including History or Geography as a Main/Elective Subject for the Prescribed Duration

Important: The notification specifically states that candidates with B.Sc. (Hons.) in Physics or Chemistry are not eligible for TGT Mathematics-Physics. Applicants must satisfy the relevant subject combination rather than relying only on their degree title.

CTET is mandatory for the applicable TGT and PRT posts.

AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

The maximum age varies from 30 to 50 years depending on the post. Principal and Vice-Principal positions also have a minimum age requirement of 35 years.

AEES posts carry pay scales under the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, ranging from Level 6 to Level 12.

The listed amounts are pay scales, not fixed in-hand salaries. Actual monthly earnings will depend on the applicable pay level, allowances and deductions.

AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

The application fee is Rs. 750 plus Rs. 250 processing fee for non-exempt candidates. Women, SC, ST, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen applicants are exempted from the application fee but must pay the processing fee.

Category Application Fee Processing Fee Total
General / OBC / EWS and Other Non-Exempt Candidates Rs. 750 Rs. 250 Rs. 1,000
Women / SC / ST / PwBD / Ex-Servicemen Nil Rs. 250 Rs. 250

Note: Applicable GST charged by the bank is additional. Payment can be made online using Debit Card, Credit Card or Net Banking. Fees paid through other modes are not accepted, and application fees once remitted are non-refundable.

Candidates applying for multiple permitted posts must pay the requisite fee separately for each post.

AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection includes a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by an Interview for Principal and Vice-Principal or a qualifying Skill Test for other posts. Medical fitness is also required before appointment.

  1. Computer Based Test (CBT).
  2. Interview for Principal and Vice-Principal, or Skill Test for teaching and Librarian posts.
  3. Verification of educational qualifications, experience and applicable certificates.
  4. Medical fitness examination before appointment.

Selection for Principal and Vice-Principal

Final selection for Principal and Vice-Principal is based on 50% CBT marks and 50% Interview marks, subject to meeting the prescribed qualifying standards separately in both stages.

Selection for PGT, TGT, Librarian, PRT and Balvatika Teacher

These candidates must qualify in the CBT and then undergo a teaching skill test conducted on a Go / No Go basis. The skill test is qualifying only, and final merit is based on CBT marks among candidates awarded Go.

The skill test assesses teaching ability through a chalk-and-board demonstration on a subject-oriented topic. Candidates receiving No Go will not be empanelled regardless of CBT marks.

AEES may lower the qualifying threshold within the notified limits if an insufficient number of candidates qualify for a particular post or category. Meeting the minimum standard does not automatically guarantee shortlisting for Skill Test or Interview.

AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026 Exam Centres

The Computer Based Test is tentatively planned across multiple cities in India, including Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Patna, Lucknow, Ahmedabad, Jaipur, Bhubaneswar, Pune and other listed centres.

AEES may change, cancel or reallocate examination centres according to administrative requirements. The Skill Test and Interview will be conducted at AEES, Anushaktinagar, Mumbai.

AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026 Apply Online

Eligible candidates can apply online through the dedicated AEES Recruitment Notification 01/2026 application portal from 2 November 2026 at 10:00 AM.

Apply Online: AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026 Application Portal

Last Date: 22 November 2026 at 11:50 PM.

Applicants must select the correct post and subject. Within PGT posts, candidates can apply for only one PGT subject; similarly, candidates can apply for only one TGT subject, even when qualified for multiple subjects.

How to Apply Online for AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026?

  1. Visit the official AEES recruitment portal at aees.onlineregistrationforms.com.
  2. Read Recruitment Notification 01/2026 and the applicable post-specific eligibility conditions.
  3. Register using a valid personal email ID and mobile number.
  4. Log in to the online application portal.
  5. Select the relevant post and permitted subject.
  6. Enter personal, educational qualification, experience and category details.
  7. Upload the photograph and required documents according to the portal instructions.
  8. Review the application and supporting information carefully.
  9. Pay the applicable application and processing fees online.
  10. Complete final submission and generate the Confirmation Page.
  11. Download and print the Confirmation Page for future reference.

Important: Applications without a generated Confirmation Page will be treated as incomplete. Candidates should not send application printouts to the AEES office by post.

Documents Required for AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026

Candidates must upload scanned documents relevant to their selected post and produce the required originals and self-attested copies during verification.

  • Recent colour photograph in the prescribed format.
  • Class 10 certificate or marksheet for date-of-birth proof.
  • Class 12 certificate and marksheet, where applicable.
  • Graduation degree and semester/year-wise marksheets.
  • Postgraduate degree and marksheets, where applicable.
  • B.Ed., D.El.Ed., B.El.Ed., Nursery Education or other prescribed teacher-training certificates.
  • CTET Paper-I or Paper-II certificate, where required.
  • Experience and service certificates for Principal, Vice-Principal or other applicable posts.
  • SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS certificate, if applicable.
  • PwBD certificate and relevant supporting documents, where applicable.
  • No Objection Certificate for serving employees, where required.
  • Other documents prescribed by the online portal for the selected post.

Document Scanning Requirement: The notification instructs candidates to use a proper scanner rather than a mobile phone camera or scanning application. File-size and format specifications must be followed as displayed on the recruitment portal.

Police Verification and NOC Requirements

Candidates reaching the Skill Test or Interview stage must satisfy the notified Police Verification Certificate requirements. Serving employees of the specified Government, PSU and autonomous organizations must produce the applicable original NOC and vigilance clearance.

AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • The recruitment is for 254 tentative vacancies under Notification 01/2026.
  • Applications are accepted online through the dedicated AEES portal only.
  • The online application window is 2 November to 22 November 2026.
  • Post-specific qualifications and CTET requirements must be satisfied by the prescribed eligibility cut-off.
  • Applicants can select only one subject within the PGT category and only one subject within the TGT category.
  • Separate fees apply when applying for different permitted posts.
  • CBT carries no negative marking.
  • Principal and Vice-Principal selection uses CBT and Interview marks with 50:50 weightage.
  • Other notified posts require a qualifying Go / No Go Skill Test after CBT.
  • Admit cards and call letters must be downloaded from the candidate login.
  • Applicants may be posted anywhere in India.
  • All appointment offers are subject to document verification and medical fitness.

What Are State PSC Jobs?

State PSC jobs are government recruitment opportunities notified through State Public Service Commissions. These commissions recruit candidates for various posts and services under state government departments according to the rules applicable to each recruitment.

State PSC recruitment is not limited to State Civil Services examinations. Public Service Commissions may also recruit candidates for engineering, medical, teaching, agriculture, legal, scientific, technical, administrative and other departmental posts.

The posts available depend on vacancies reported by the respective state government departments and the recruitment notifications issued by the commission.

Popular Posts Recruited Through State PSCs

State Public Service Commissions recruit candidates for a wide range of government posts. Common recruitment categories may include:

  • State Civil Services
  • Administrative Services
  • Assistant Commissioner
  • Assistant Director
  • Assistant Professor
  • Lecturer
  • Medical Officer
  • Veterinary Officer
  • Assistant Engineer
  • Assistant Executive Engineer
  • Agriculture Officer
  • Food Safety Officer
  • Drug Inspector
  • Scientific Officer
  • Law Officer
  • Labour Officer
  • Revenue-related Posts
  • Technical Officers
  • Departmental Officers

The actual posts available vary by commission and recruitment notification.

PSC Jobs by Group (Group 1, 2, 2A, 4 & Others)

Several State Public Service Commissions including TNPSC, APPSC, and TSPSC classify recruitment into numbered "Groups" based on post seniority, pay scale, and administrative responsibility. Understanding these groups helps candidates identify which exam to prepare for based on their qualification and career goals.

Group Typical Posts Minimum Qualification Selection Stages
Group 1 Deputy Collector, DSP, Assistant Commissioner, District Registrar Bachelor's degree Prelims + Mains + Interview
Group 2 Assistant Section Officer, Tehsildar, Municipal Commissioner (Grade), Block Development Officer Bachelor's degree Prelims + Mains (some states include Interview)
Group 2A Junior Assistant, Bill Collector, Field Surveyor Bachelor's degree Written Exam (Certificate Verification)
Group 3 Various department Grade II/Non-Gazetted posts Varies by post Written Exam
Group 4 Junior Assistant, Typist, Steno-Typist, Bill Collector, Record Clerk, Village Administrative Officer (VAO) SSLC / 10th or 12th pass (varies by post) Single Written Exam (Certificate Verification)

Group numbering, post names, and minimum qualifications vary by state the table above reflects the common pattern used by TNPSC-style classification. Some states use different group labels or don't use numbered groups at all. Always confirm the exact group structure and eligibility on your state PSC's official notification.

Who Should Apply for Group 4?

Group 4 posts are typically entry-level government jobs open to candidates who have completed SSLC (10th) or Higher Secondary (12th), making them one of the most accessible and high-demand categories of PSC recruitment. These posts don't usually require a specific degree, have a single-stage written exam, and see some of the highest applicant volumes of any PSC exam due to the lower qualification bar and large number of annual vacancies.

State PSC Eligibility Criteria

There is no single eligibility rule for all State PSC jobs. Qualification, age limit, experience and other conditions differ depending on the commission and post.

Eligibility Criteria General Guidance
Educational Qualification Depends on the post and may include Diploma, Graduation, Engineering, Medicine, Law, Post Graduation or another prescribed qualification.
Age Limit Minimum and maximum age limits vary by commission and recruitment.
Age Relaxation Relaxation may be available to eligible categories according to the rules applicable to the recruitment.
State / Domicile Conditions State-specific eligibility, reservation, language or residency conditions may apply to certain recruitments.
Experience Some technical, teaching, specialist or senior posts require relevant professional experience.
Number of Attempts Attempt restrictions apply only where specifically prescribed for an examination or recruitment.

Important: Candidates should check the detailed recruitment notification before applying because eligibility conditions differ for every State PSC recruitment.

State PSC Selection Process

The State PSC selection process depends on the commission and the type of post. There is no single selection procedure followed for every PSC recruitment.

Depending on the recruitment, the selection process may include one or more of the following stages:

  • Preliminary Examination
  • Main Examination
  • Written Examination
  • Screening Test
  • Subject-specific Examination
  • Skill Test
  • Physical Test
  • Interview / Personality Test
  • Document Verification
  • Medical Examination

State Civil Services examinations may have Preliminary, Main and Interview stages, while technical, medical, teaching and departmental recruitment may follow a different selection process.

Always check the individual recruitment notification for the exact examination and selection procedure.

How to Apply for State PSC Jobs 2026

The application process differs slightly between commissions, but candidates can generally follow these steps:

  1. Find the required State PSC recruitment from the latest jobs table above.
  2. Open the detailed recruitment page.
  3. Check the post name, vacancies, qualification, age limit, application fee and important dates.
  4. Read the official recruitment notification carefully.
  5. Open the official application website or application link.
  6. Complete registration or One-Time Registration if required by the commission.
  7. Enter the required personal, educational and category details.
  8. Upload the prescribed photograph, signature and supporting documents.
  9. Pay the application fee if applicable.
  10. Review the application before final submission.
  11. Submit the application before the specified last date.
  12. Save or print the submitted application for future reference.

Candidates should submit applications only through the application method specified in the official notification.

State PSC Exam Pattern and Syllabus

There is no common exam pattern or syllabus for all State PSC recruitments.

State Civil Services examinations generally cover broader subjects such as General Studies and state-specific topics, while technical, medical, engineering, teaching and departmental recruitment may focus more heavily on subjects related to the post.

The following can differ between recruitments:

  • Number of papers
  • Objective or descriptive examination
  • Total marks
  • Exam duration
  • Negative marking
  • Minimum qualifying marks
  • Language requirements
  • Subject-specific syllabus
  • Interview or skill test requirements

Candidates should refer to the syllabus and exam pattern issued for the specific State PSC recruitment they are applying for.

State PSC Jobs vs UPSC Jobs

State Public Service Commissions and the Union Public Service Commission conduct different recruitment processes.

State PSC UPSC
Conducts recruitment for posts and services connected with the respective state. Conducts recruitment and examinations for various Union Government and All India Services posts.
Recruitment rules differ from one State PSC to another. Recruitment is conducted under the rules applicable to UPSC examinations and vacancies.
May recruit for State Civil Services, engineering, medical, teaching, technical and departmental posts. Conducts Civil Services Examination and various other recruitment examinations for Union Government posts.

Candidates looking for Union Government recruitment through UPSC can visit the UPSC Jobs page.

PSC vs PCS - What Is the Difference?

PSC stands for Public Service Commission. It refers to the constitutional commission responsible for conducting recruitment for various government posts and services within its jurisdiction.

PCS commonly refers to Provincial Civil Service or State Civil Services posts and examinations.

A State Public Service Commission may conduct a State Civil Services or PCS examination, but it can also conduct recruitment for many other positions such as Medical Officer, Assistant Engineer, Lecturer, Agriculture Officer and departmental posts.

Therefore, State PSC Jobs covers a broader range of recruitment than only PCS or State Civil Services examinations.

How to Choose the Right State PSC Recruitment

Before applying for a State PSC vacancy, candidates should compare the recruitment requirements with their qualification and preferences.

Check the following details:

  • Required educational qualification
  • Age limit
  • Category and reservation conditions
  • State or language requirements, if any
  • Number of vacancies
  • Pay scale or salary
  • Job location
  • Application fee
  • Selection process
  • Examination pattern
  • Application deadline

Apply only after confirming that you meet the eligibility conditions mentioned in the official recruitment notification.

State PSC Recruitment Updates You Should Check

A recruitment notification can sometimes be followed by additional notices from the commission. Candidates should continue checking recruitment updates even after submitting their application.

Important updates may include:

  • Application date extension
  • Correction window
  • Vacancy revision
  • Exam date
  • Exam city information
  • Admit card
  • Answer key
  • Result
  • Interview schedule
  • Document verification schedule
  • Final selection result

Relevant updates should be linked from the individual recruitment page whenever they are released.

Why Check State PSC Jobs on OnlyJobs?

OnlyJobs brings State Public Service Commission recruitment information together in one place so candidates can quickly find current opportunities without checking multiple commission websites individually.

For each recruitment, candidates can find important details such as:

  • Recruiting commission
  • Post name
  • Total vacancies
  • Educational qualification
  • Age limit
  • Salary or pay scale
  • Application fee
  • Selection process
  • Application dates
  • Official notification
  • Official application link

Recruitment information should be checked against the official State Public Service Commission notification before publication. Important corrections, vacancy revisions and date extensions should also be updated whenever they are released.

Latest State PSC Notifications - Frequently Asked Questions

What are State PSC Jobs?

State PSC Jobs are government recruitment opportunities notified through State Public Service Commissions for various posts and services under state government departments.

Which State PSC jobs are currently open?

Currently open recruitments are listed in the Latest State PSC Jobs 2026 table at the top of this page. The list is updated when new recruitment notifications and application updates are released.

Where can I find the latest State PSC recruitment notifications?

You can check the latest State PSC recruitment notifications on this page or select your commission from the State-wise PSC Jobs section to find recruitment specific to your state.

What qualification is required for State PSC jobs?

There is no single qualification required for all State PSC jobs. Depending on the post, candidates may need a Diploma, Graduation, Engineering degree, Medical qualification, Law degree, Post Graduation or another specified qualification.

Are all State PSC jobs for graduates?

No. Eligibility depends on the individual recruitment. Many administrative posts require a degree, while technical, professional and departmental posts may have different qualification requirements.

What is the age limit for State PSC jobs?

The minimum and maximum age limits vary according to the commission and post. Candidates should check the age criteria given in the individual recruitment notification.

Is age relaxation available for State PSC recruitment?

Age relaxation may be available to eligible categories according to the rules applicable to the respective recruitment. The exact relaxation should be checked in the official notification.

Is domicile compulsory for State PSC jobs?

Not for every State PSC recruitment. Some vacancies may have state-specific residency, reservation, language or other eligibility requirements. Candidates should check the relevant recruitment rules before applying.

What is the selection process for State PSC jobs?

The selection process varies by post. It may include a Preliminary Examination, Main Examination, written test, screening test, skill test, interview, physical test, document verification or medical examination.

Do all State PSC recruitments have Prelims and Mains?

No. Prelims and Mains are common in some State Civil Services examinations, but many technical, medical, teaching and departmental recruitments follow a different examination or selection process.

How can I apply for State PSC recruitment?

Open the required recruitment from the latest jobs table, read the eligibility and application details, check the official notification and use the official application link provided on the recruitment page.

What is the difference between State PSC and UPSC?

State PSCs conduct recruitment mainly for posts and services connected with their respective states, while UPSC conducts recruitment and examinations for various Union Government and All India Services posts.

Is PSC the same as PCS?

No. PSC means Public Service Commission, while PCS generally refers to Provincial Civil Service or State Civil Services. A State PSC can recruit for PCS as well as many other administrative, technical, medical and departmental posts.

Where can I check State PSC admit cards?

When an admit card is released, the related recruitment page should be updated with the admit card information and official download link. Candidates can also check the OnlyJobs Admit Card section.

Where can I check State PSC results?

State PSC result updates can be checked through the individual recruitment page or the OnlyJobs Results section.

How often is this State PSC Jobs page updated?

The page is updated when new State PSC recruitment notifications, application extensions and other important recruitment updates become available.

What Is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job is any government job opportunity offered across India's central and state government departments - spanning all 28 states and 8 union territories. The term "Bharat" simply emphasises pan-India coverage: a Bharat Sarkari Job notification could originate from a central body like the SSC, UPSC, or Indian Railways, or from a state public service commission recruiting for state-level posts. Regardless of origin, these roles share the defining traits Indian aspirants seek - long-term job security, government pay scales, and statutory retirement benefits.

Sarkari Job vs Private Job

A sarkari job differs from private-sector employment in a few important ways: government positions are governed by service rules that protect against arbitrary termination, salaries follow Pay Commission recommendations rather than market negotiation, and employees are entitled to pension schemes (NPS or OPS depending on recruitment year), medical coverage under CGHS, and fixed working hours. Private jobs, by contrast, often offer higher starting pay in competitive fields but carry less structural job security.

Sarkari Bharat Vacancies by Sector

Sarkari bharat vacancies span several major recruiting sectors. Each sector below links to a dedicated hub page with sector-specific notifications, eligibility criteria, and exam patterns.

Railway Jobs (RRB NTPC, ALP, Group D)

Indian Railways is the country's largest single recruiter, with RRB NTPC, Group D, ALP, JE, and Technician posts opening in large batches. Check live Railway vacancies on our Railway Jobs hub.

Defence Jobs (Army, Navy, Air Force)

Defence recruitment covers Indian Army (including Agniveer), Navy, Air Force, BSF, CRPF, CISF, and ITBP postings. See ongoing openings on our Defence Jobs hub.

Teaching Jobs (KVS, NVS, State Boards)

SSC & UPSC Notifications

SSC (CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD) and UPSC (Civil Services, CDS, NDA) notifications remain the most closely tracked central-government exams. Full notification archives are available on our SSC Jobs and UPSC Jobs hubs.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 कैसे भरें? (How to Apply Online)

हर साल लाखों उम्मीदवार सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 भरने की प्रक्रिया में गलतियाँ कर बैठते हैं, जिससे उनका आवेदन रद्द हो सकता है। नीचे दी गई सरल प्रक्रिया से आप अपना फॉर्म सही तरीके से भर सकते हैं।

आवेदन की चरणबद्ध प्रक्रिया

  1. संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना (Notification PDF) ध्यान से पढ़ें और अपनी पात्रता जांचें।
  2. वैध ईमेल आईडी और मोबाइल नंबर से पोर्टल पर पंजीकरण (Registration) करें।
  3. व्यक्तिगत विवरण, शैक्षणिक योग्यता, और आवश्यक दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें (फोटो, हस्ताक्षर, प्रमाणपत्र)।
  4. निर्धारित आवेदन शुल्क का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करें और भुगतान की रसीद सुरक्षित रखें।
  5. फॉर्म सबमिट करने से पहले सभी जानकारी की दोबारा जांच करें और फॉर्म का प्रिंटआउट अवश्य लें।

Documents Required for Sarkari Form

Typical documents needed: recent passport-size photograph (as per specified size/format), scanned signature, educational certificates and mark sheets, category certificate (if applicable), and a valid ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN).

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying

  • Submitting a photo or signature that doesn't match the specified pixel/size requirements.
  • Missing the last date due to server load - apply at least 2–3 days before deadline.
  • Entering a name or date of birth that doesn't match your certificates exactly.
  • Forgetting to download and save the final submitted form and payment receipt.

A Bharat Sarkari Job refers to any government job opportunity across India's central and state departments - including Railways, Banking, SSC, UPSC, Defence, Police, and PSUs - offering job security, fixed pay scales, and pension benefits under government service rules.

How can I get instant Sarkari Job Alert notifications?

How do I find a Sarkari Job that matches my qualification?

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 में आवेदन कैसे करें?

सबसे पहले संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना पढ़ें, पात्रता जांचें, फिर वैध ईमेल और मोबाइल नंबर से रजिस्ट्रेशन करके फॉर्म भरें, दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें और आवेदन शुल्क जमा करें।

Is OnlyJobs reliable for sarkarijob updates?

Yes - OnlyJobs has tracked sarkarijob notifications since 2011, cross-verifying every listing against official department websites before publishing.

What is the difference between a Sarkari Job and a private-sector job?

Sarkari jobs offer government-backed job security, pension (NPS/OPS), fixed working hours, and statutory benefits, while private jobs typically offer market-driven pay with fewer long-term security guarantees.

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Overview

Anganwadi recruitment is conducted through different state and district authorities. Application dates, post names, eligibility, selection methods and vacancies depend on the individual notification.

How to Apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026

Candidates can submit the Anganwadi Form 2026 online or offline according to the instructions in the specific recruitment advertisement. There is no single online application process for every state.

  1. Choose your state, district and post from the recruitment list.
  2. Open the detailed notification and verify the last date.
  3. Confirm your qualification, age and local residence eligibility.
  4. Follow the official online application link or obtain the prescribed offline form.
  5. Complete the required information and submit the specified documents.
  6. Pay the application fee only if required by the notification.
  7. Submit before the closing deadline and retain the acknowledgement or submission record where provided.

Documents for Anganwadi Online or Offline Application

Depending on the notification, applicants may need proof of educational qualification, age, local residence, category and identity. Photograph, signature and other supporting certificates should be prepared in the format prescribed by the authority. The exact document list must be checked before applying.

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 FAQs

What is the last date for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?

There is no common last date for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026. Each state or district publishes its own closing date. Check the live recruitment table for the applicable notification.

Where can I apply for Anganwadi jobs online in 2026?

Apply through the official state or district recruitment portal mentioned in the specific advertisement. Some Anganwadi recruitments require offline applications instead.

Is Anganwadi Supervisor Vacancy 2026 available?

Supervisor vacancies are announced separately by the relevant recruitment authorities. Candidates should confirm an active Supervisor notification before applying.

What is the last date for Anganwadi Supervisor Vacancy 2026?

The last date depends on the state and the Supervisor advertisement. Worker and Helper application deadlines do not automatically apply to Supervisor posts.

Can 10th or 12th pass candidates apply for Anganwadi jobs?

Yes, some Anganwadi Worker and Helper notifications accept Class 10 or Class 12 qualifications. The required qualification depends on the post and recruiting authority.

Is there an examination for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?

The selection method depends on the official notification. Candidates should check whether the recruitment involves academic merit, a written examination, interview or other prescribed stages.

How can I find Anganwadi Vacancy 2026 in Haryana or Telangana?

Check the state-wise recruitment section and open the relevant district notification. Verify the post, vacancy, deadline and application mode before applying.

Where can I find Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 in Maharashtra?

Check the relevant Maharashtra Women and Child Development or district recruitment notification for Anganwadi Sevika, Helper and Supervisor vacancies, as applicable.

Is wcd.gov.in the Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 official website?

The central Ministry of Women and Child Development website is wcd.gov.in. Recruitment application portals differ by state and district, so applicants must use the portal specified in their notification.

Can I apply for an Anganwadi vacancy in another district?

That depends on the recruitment's residence and eligibility rules. Some Worker and Helper notices require candidates to belong to a particular village, ward or project area.

Forest Guard Recruitment 2026 - Latest Vacancies & Eligibility

Forest Guard recruitment is suitable for candidates interested in forest protection, patrolling and field-level government work. Forest Guard vacancies are generally announced by state forest departments or authorized recruitment boards.

What does a Forest Guard do?

A Forest Guard helps protect forest areas, monitor activities, assist with wildlife conservation and report suspected forest offences. Duties can include patrolling assigned forest areas and supporting senior forest officials.

What is the qualification for Forest Guard Recruitment 2026?

Some Forest Guard recruitments require Class 10 or Class 12 qualifications from a recognized board. However, the exact educational requirements depend on the state and recruitment notification.

Candidates should check:

  • Education: Required qualification and recognized board.
  • Age Limit: Minimum and maximum age, including the age-calculation date.
  • Physical Standards: Height, chest measurements or other applicable requirements.
  • Selection Process: Written examination, physical tests or other notified stages.
  • Vacancies: Total and category-wise posts.
  • Application Dates: Registration opening and closing dates.

How can I apply for Forest Guard Vacancy 2026?

Find the Forest Guard recruitment in the vacancy table above, open the detailed notification, confirm eligibility and follow the official application instructions.

Candidates should apply only through the website or submission method prescribed by the recruiting authority.

Forest Range Officer Recruitment 2026 - RFO Jobs

Forest Range Officer Recruitment 2026 provides opportunities for candidates interested in forest administration, conservation and supervisory roles.

A Forest Range Officer, also referred to as a Range Forest Officer or RFO in some recruitment systems, may oversee forest protection activities, supervise field staff and manage responsibilities within an assigned forest range.

What is the qualification for Forest Range Officer recruitment?

Forest Range Officer recruitment generally involves graduate-level eligibility. Some notifications require degrees in specified subjects such as science, agriculture, forestry or other approved disciplines.

The accepted qualifications vary by recruiting organization. A graduation degree alone does not automatically make a candidate eligible for every RFO vacancy.

How are Forest Range Officers selected?

Depending on the recruitment rules, selection may include:

  • Preliminary or main written examinations
  • Physical standards or fitness assessments
  • Interviews, where prescribed
  • Document verification
  • Medical examination

Candidates searching for RFO Vacancy 2026, Forest Ranger Recruitment or Forest Range Service Officer notifications should check the relevant vacancy details for exact eligibility and selection stages.

Forest-related government jobs include field protection, administration, conservation, research and technical positions.

Which Forest Department post should you apply for? Choose a post based on your educational qualification, age, physical eligibility, preferred work and the conditions specified in the official notification.

The availability of these posts varies by recruitment cycle and state.
